description: This PHP class defines the Free shipping model in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It calculates if free shipping applies based on configuration, geo zone, and cart subtotal, and returns shipping method details accordingly.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Handles the logic for determining if free shipping is available and provides shipping method data based on cart subtotal and geo zone restrictions.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns the free shipping quote based on address, cart subtotal, and geo zone configuration.
